title: Assefa holds on for 2:11:04 as Adola regains Berlin crown
claims: The 2026 BMW BERLIN-MARATHON was a World Athletics Platinum Label road race held on Sunday 27 September 2026.
Tigst Assefa won the women's race in 2:11:04, the third-fastest time in history, taking 49 seconds off her own course record of 2:11:53 from 2023.
Guye Adola won the men's race in 2:02:50, with Gemechu Dida second in 2:03:19 and Gabriel Geay third in 2:03:59.
Assefa passed 5 km in 15:30, 10 km in 30:48, 20 km in 1:01:34, halfway in 1:04:57, 25 km in 1:17:00, 30 km in 1:32:15, 35 km in 1:47:32 and 40 km in 2:03:00.
Adola passed 10 km in 28:58, halfway in 1:01:01 and 30 km in 1:26:57.
The women's podium was completed by Bedatu Hirpa in 2:16:53 and Dera Dida in 2:16:55.
